description:
The United States Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM) / Directorate of Acquisition anticipates issuing a Request for Quote (RFQ) on or about 20 March 2026. The 595th Transportation Surface Brigade (TSB) provides United States Army Transportation Command (ARTRANS) forward presence in order to coordinate redeployment support, container and cargo/freight management, and door-to-door/door-to-port/port-to-port/port-to-door surface distribution operations in the United States Central Command (USCENTCOM) area of responsibility (AOR). The brigade manages Universal Services Contract (USC), Multi-Modal (MM), and Military Sealift Command (MSC) Chartered, cargoes entering and exiting the Theater of Operations (TO). In support of this critical task, the 595th TSB requires contract deployment and distribution service support for traffic management services, related vessel services support, documentation not limited to Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES) transaction (e.g. Cargo Manifest (DD Form 1385), Working/Final Vessel Papers, tally transactions, reconciliation, etc.), USCENTCOM Custom Clearance support (e.g. AK-302, JOC-I, MOFA, MAP Memo, etc.), and Track and Trace system and report capability (Daily ITV reports, yard reports, booked cargo reports, etc.). Coordination with the operations, yard, and vessel team members is critical to ensure data accuracy. The primary place of performance is the Military port of Shuaiba, otherwise known as Camp Spearhead.

The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price contract resulting from a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) source selection. The period of performance for the proposed solicitation, HTC71126QE130, will consist of a one (1) year base period from 1 September 2026 through 31 August 2027, four (4) one year option periods, and one (1) six month extension of service. The applicable Product Service Code (PSC) is R706, and the North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code is 561110 with a size standard of $12.5 million. This requirement will be solicited using a Full and Open Competition acquisition strategy. No hardcopies of this solicitation will be issued.  All responsible sources may submit a quote, which shall be considered by the Agency. The contracting office is USTRANSCOM, 508 Scott Drive, Scott AFB, IL 62225. All comments should be addressed in writing to Ms. Aliyah Williams and Ms. Sarah Albers via email: aliyah.s.williams4.civ@mail.mil and sarah.l.albers2.civ@mail.mil.
